gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/dialog/mar: Blaze rods and nether wart — now I can finally study this 'brewing' business. Thanks again this time!
Blaze rods and nether wart — I'm itchin' to fire up a brewing stand and study 'em!
Okay, I admit I'm rushing — go on, get going.
Different schools, y'know — but what you describe interests me too. Fetch me some of both — price is negotiable!
Fine, I'm real patient — tell me when you're free?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/option/com: We each get what we need.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/option/fol: I haven't actually gone yet — don't rush me.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/option/sta: Come to think of it, brewing here is nothing like those witches' — shouldn't it be blazes and nether wart based?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/quest/desc: Bring Marisa blaze rods and nether wart.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat/dialog/marisa: Used to get plenty, but everything around here changed big-time lately — no idea where my customers went.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat/greeting: Yo, hey~ welcome to the Kirisame Magic Shop!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat/trade: Wanna see the goods? Check out what I just got today!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_morichika/dia: Not all of 'em — there's another shop in this Magical Forest, Kourindou, run by Rinnosuke Morichika. Got some history with him — anyway, he deals all kinds of curios, kinda a secondhand shop.
Sells everything from charms to junk — and he'll buy your spare curios too.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_morichika/opt: I'll have to pay it a visit sometime.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_morichika/sta: Did you make all these little trinkets yourself?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_reimu/dialog/: You'll find the Hakurei Shrine out in the cherry grove — an old friend of mine's there, a real incident-resolving expert.
If raiders come at you, go find her — she'll chase them off. Just don't forget the donation, okay?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_reimu/option/: Anything I should know before visiting?
I'll drop by when I get the chance.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_reimu/starter: I heard the Hakurei Shrine helped lots of villages — what's that place?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_brewing/dial: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see.
Blaze rods and nether wart — remember!
Hurry back — the brew waits for no one!
Brewin' up a storm over here, and I'm fresh outta base ingredients! Please head to the Nether and grab me some blaze rods and nether wart.
Aw, don't leave me hangin'! The brew won't brew itself!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_brewing/ques: Bring Marisa blaze rods and nether wart.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_mycelium/dia: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see!
Oh, these are perfect! Thanks, buddy!
Stock's runnin' low again — the glowing ones, the dreamy ones, whatever ya can find. Remember?
That's the spirit! Bring me the good stuff!
Morning! My stock's runnin' low again. Bring me a fresh bundle of forest mushrooms — the glowing ones, the dreamy ones, whatever ya can find. Fresh research material, stat!
Aw, c'mon! The specialty mushrooms are the best part of this world's flora!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_shroomlight/: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see.
Nether fungus and shroomlights — remember, okay?
I need more Nether shroomlights and fungus — help me out~
What? The Nether's not that bad! Just watch out for the lava!
Bring Marisa shroomlights and nether fungus.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_talisman/dia: Healing papers — I burn through 'em fast with all my experimenting. Gotta keep 'em stocked!
Good, waiting for you to get back!
Thanks! Still the usual four, got it?
Yo! I've already used up the papers — help me make another trip to Reimu's and buy a few more healing papers, would ya?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_talisman/que: Bring Marisa healing talisman papers from Reimu.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_witchcraft/d: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see!
Rotten flesh, spider eyes, miasma mushrooms — don't forget.
Good, I'll have the brew ready!
Thanks — waiting for you to get back!
Yo! I'm mid-brew and runnin' short on necro-materials. Think ya can scrounge up some rotten flesh, spider eyes, and a few miasma mushrooms? For, uh... research. Yeah. Research.
What, too gross? Magic research can't be picky! Please!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_witchcraft/q: Bring Marisa rotten flesh, spider eyes, and miasma mushrooms.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/first_mushroom/dia: Ohoho, these are perfect! Just the right moisture and bite. This'll jump-start my research something fierce!
Sure, no rush. Come back when you're ready.
Hey, I'm not that kind of client — so how's the job going?
Take your time — just don't skimp on me, now!
You're a lifesaver! — Eight red and eight brown mushrooms'll do. Bring me the good stuff!

A new face! Marisa Kirisame, the ordinary magician, reportin' for duty, ze! I'm Marisa Kirisame the magician — just an ordinary human, ze! Say, you live around here, right? This area's still real strange to me — even the forest plants look different. I'm just getting my magic research started and I'm short on honest-to-goodness samples. How about fetching me some red and brown mushrooms?
Aw, c'mon~ Mushrooms are the foundation of every potion recipe — you'd be helping real magic research here!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/first_mushroom/opt: Sorry, looks like I don't have enough.
Just double-checking — the request hasn't changed, right?
I saw some requests posted outside your shop?
Okay, wait for me to get back.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/first_mushroom/que: Bring Marisa red and brown mushrooms from the surface.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/golden_apple/dialo: Look at that glow — that's genuine lost technology. I'm gonna take it apart, learn every secret inside, and build my own!
Hey — ever heard of appreciating the moment?!
I hear there are lots of abandoned buildings underground — rummage through chests and you'll run into one.
No pressure — this request has no deadline.

Ever seen those fancy golden apples — the glowy kind? Nobody in this world knows how to make 'em anymore, but I reckon I can figure it out! Find me one as a sample and I'll reverse-engineer the whole thing, then share the knowledge. Whaddaya say?
Rare stuff is exactly the fun stuff! No hurry — look around when ya can.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/golden_apple/optio: Finally — never mind how I got it, I found one.
No need to take it apart — you can just bite right in.
Finally a request that's not about mushrooms?
Taking it or not, same thing really — wish me luck.
Too hard to find — I don't want it.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/golden_apple/quest: Bring Marisa an enchanted golden apple.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/huge_mushroom/dial: THESE! Feel that? They're packed full of magic!
You're a lifesaver! Now I've got dinner and research!
I need whole blocks of those giant mushrooms — got any yet? I can hardly wait!
Okay, okay — just don't bring me crumbs. I want whole blocks!
Now that's a good assistant! Bring 'em back intact — caps and stems, either kind is fine. I'll be sitting tight!

Speaking of which — have ya seen the mushrooms around here? They're practically trees! I've never seen anything this huge — real whoppers. I tried pluckin' one, but it just shattered into little bits in my hands. There's gotta be a proper way to harvest the solid blocks. Think ya can bring me some whole giant mushroom blocks?
Tried it! They shatter into tiny bits — useless to me. I need 'em in whole blocks — that's your specialty, right?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/huge_mushroom/opti: Took some doing, but I got it — here you go.
Wait — you're gonna eat your research results?
Wait for me to get back.
Uh... why don't you try yourself? It's close by.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/koishi_hat/dialog/: Not a scratch? Knew you had it in you — travelers stopped ravin' about bein' followed, too.
Haha! Another mystery laid to rest — this is for you.
Best if nothing's wrong — but while you were gone, travelers started going missing.
That's fine too — best stay out of the Nether till this blows over.

Heard the news coming outta the Nether lately? Travelers comin' back white as sheets, swearin' somethin' followed 'em home — but none of 'em can say what. Gives me the creeps just thinkin' about it, ze. You're braver than me, though. Poke around down there for me, would ya? And... watch yourself.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/koishi_hat/option/: I ran into what you mentioned — and I dealt with it.
Then I'll take it with a clear conscience.
Hm — nothing seems to be happening?
That dangerous? Boss, I've suddenly lost my nerve.
What's with the hush-hush request — what's going on?
Really? I'll go take a look.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/koishi_hat/quest/d: Marisa heard unsettling rumors about the Nether. Investigate — carefully.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/nether_mushroom_pr: Wow, look at this — it's like a living chunk of sulfur! That this world's plants can adapt to that place is fascinating. Amazing research material — thank you!
I need Nether mushrooms — found any yet? I hear they grow like weeds down there.
Knew I could count on ya! Bring those mushrooms back safe!

The big-nosed natives around here say the mushrooms down there are something else entirely. No way I'm going there myself — all that fire and lava, and it ain't anything like the Former Hell. But you've been there, right? Bring me back some Nether mushrooms!
Heh, fair enough. But that's where the really good research material is! Come back when you're feelin' brave.
You're too kind — I got paid for it, after all.
I saw the new request — has your mushroom obsession spread to the Nether?
I know the place — I can handle this.
Uh, I don't dare go there yet.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/shared/option/dail: Could you go over the task again?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/shroomlight/dialog: Ohhh, so pretty! And look at the structure inside this stem! The magic must flow right through here.
You gettin' any of that glowing stuff? I wanna see how it lights up!
Take care down there — don't get turned into a mushroom yourself!
Now we're talkin'! Glowing cores — as many as ya can carry!
I hear the Nether has giant mushrooms too — with flesh like wood! And a glowing core inside, right? I need that thing — bring me back a few.
Hehe, I didn't know about this stuff last time — one more trip, pretty please.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/shroomlight/option: Just saying — the glowy ones are usually poisonous.
What's this glowing mushroom in the request?
Why didn't you have me bring it last time...
gensokyolegacy/marisa/talisman_request/d: That's it! One ofuda and every ache is gone — I never could've asked her myself without you.
Aw, never mind that — I've got good stuff for you too: a doll glove and a fresh doll, handmade by Alice herself, plus a star wand of my own making. Keep it secret for me!
Healing papers — Reimu sells 'em at the shrine — four of 'em, burn that into your brain!
Her prices are brutal, huh? But worth every emerald, trust me!
Great! Four healing papers — no knockoffs, got it?

Say — you've seen Reimu's ofuda, right? Those little papers pack a real punch! Lately my experiments keep leaving me singed, and healing's such a hassle. I wanna keep four for myself. Reimu sells 'em, so bring your emeralds. And... don't tell her they're for me. Whaddaya say?
Reimu charges even me full price — and she'd tease me about it forever. Just help me out here.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/talisman_request/o: You didn't ask at all, though.
At this point I kinda have to.
What was I supposed to buy again?
Ugh, so I'm paying out of pocket after all.
Aren't you two close? Why not ask her yourself?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/talisman_request/q: Bring Marisa healing talisman papers from Reimu.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat/dialog/mor: Welcome to Kourindou! Let me know if anything catches your eye.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat/greeting: Welcome to Kourindou! Feel free to look around.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat/trade: Any special offers for a special customer?
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat_marisa/dia: Marisa Kirisame, the ordinary magician. Her house is deep in the Magical Forest. She loves mushrooms, magic tools, and borrowing things without asking.
Follow the mushrooms — and the explosions. Tell her Rinnosuke sent you.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat_reimu/dial: Just don't forget a donation. A shrine maiden with an empty donation box is a grumpy shrine maiden.
Reimu Hakurei, the shrine maiden of the Hakurei Shrine in the cherry grove. If raiders trouble you, she's the one to see.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat/greeting: Hi! What brings you to the shrine?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat/trade: I'd like to trade with you!
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_duty/dialog/re: Back in Gensokyo, my job was simple, really — keeping Gensokyo in order. Put bluntly: wherever trouble broke out, I'd rush over and beat up whoever started it... Sounds exhausting, right? And it's year-round with no pay.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_fortune/dialog: Ugh, worst fortune. Dark clouds ahead — trouble finds people with luck like this. Keep your head down for a while.
Great blessing! Even I'm jealous. Take this luck and put it to work — rare drops will find you for a while.
Middle blessing. Not bad, not great. Your hands will just move faster for a while — don't waste it.
The shrine finally has its own fortune sticks. I blessed them myself, so they actually work. Good luck sticks around, bad luck... also sticks around. One draw per day — the gods get tired too.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_frog/dialog/re: Suwako is a frog goddess, after all. If she blessed frogs like that, maybe they'd develop a taste for raiders. Faith from frogs... heh, that'd be one way to gather it.
That straw hat... it would look funny on a frog, wouldn't it?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_guests/dialog/: Visitors? Back then it was mostly youkai — I barely saw any humans. A place meant for human worship, yet every day a crowd of youkai gathered to mooch food and drink. Over time the youkai grew more numerous and the humans fewer... Whatever. Donations barely amounted to anything anyway. Whoever comes, at least it's lively.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_marisa/dialog/: Have you met Marisa yet? Ordinary magician, lives deep in the Magical Forest. Loud, nosy, always borrowing things.
Her house is deep in the Magical Forest. Follow the mushrooms — and the explosions. You can't miss her.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_money/dialog/r: Isn't that obvious? Running a shrine nobody visits, I can't even cover basic living expenses. Of course I need money...
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_money/starter/: Do you care a lot about money?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_power/dialog/r: My abilities? Why ask all of a sudden... It's the ability to fly through the sky, of course... Besides that, my intuition is scary accurate. How exactly it works, I couldn't tell you myself.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_shrine/dialog/: Oh, a visitor. This is the Hakurei Shrine — though if you came to worship, you'll have to wait a while. I still haven't figured out what's going on around here.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_shrine_close/d: This shrine sits in the middle of nowhere, but back in Gensokyo its fusui was one of a kind. After all, this place is the border between Gensokyo and the outside world — at least, that's what Yukari says... But being this remote has a downside: hardly anyone comes to worship, and lately not even the youkai show up... What am I supposed to do? Moving isn't an option.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_shrine_close/s: Tell me more about the shrine.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_food/dialog/r: Just what the shrine needed. Thanks.
The donation box is empty again — bring a decent haul of supplies, remember.
Take your time. Just bring back something useful.
Good. Bring back a decent haul.
The donation box is empty again, and I'm hungry. Bring me a few things for the shrine.
A hungry miko is a distracted miko. Your call.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_food/quest/de: Bring Reimu a few supplies for the shrine.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_hunt/dialog/r: Something's been stirring near the shrine again — thin them out and bring back their loot, remember.
Stay careful out there. I need you in one piece.
That's the spirit. Go clear them out.
Something's been stirring up trouble near the shrine. Thin out the monsters and bring me some loot.
They'll only grow bolder. But it's your call.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_hunt/quest/de: Thin out the monsters and bring Reimu some loot.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_raid/dialog/r: The village is still standing. You're getting good at this.
The mark is fading. Ready for another round? I can set a fresh one.
There. Enter the village, hold the line, and drive them out. I'll be here after.
Here's the mark, same as before. Enter the village, hold the line, and drive them out.
A new mark is ready, and another village could use protecting. Ready for another raid?
The mark will keep. The raiders will still be there when you're ready.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_raid/quest/de: Win a raid with Reimu's mark to protect a village.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_talisman/dial: Good. The shelves are stocked again.
Talisman stock is low again — paper for folding, redstone for ink, remember.
The ofuda shelves are starting to look empty.
Great. Restock me and I'll keep the shrine warded.
Talisman stock is running low again. Paper and redstone, just like before.
No stock, no warding. Your call.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_talisman/ques: Bring Reimu paper and redstone to restock her talismans.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ender_materials/dia: Perfect. With these I can anchor a real gap. The road home just got a little closer.
No rush. So long as you keep them safe.
Pearls drop from those little purple rascals in the dark. The eyes you'll have to find deeper down.
One pearl and one eye, then. Rare stuff, but that's exactly what I need for the binding.

They fold space to blink across the world, right? I want that trick for my gap portal. This world's ender pearl bends space like a miniature gap, and an eye can lock onto the way home. Bring me one of each — I think I can anchor a route through them.
They're hard to come by. Come back when you've got some to spare.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ender_materials/que: Bring Reimu an ender pearl and an ender eye for her gap research.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/hostile_loot/dialog: Oh, you're back. How did it go?
That was quick. Guess I can count on you after all. You didn't get bitten, did you? I wonder how the zombies here differ from the ones back home... With these I can study them properly.
No rush, really. But watch yourself while hunting — don't get bitten. Zombies are a lot of trouble.
How's the zombie and skeleton hunting going?
Oh — I see. While you're driving them off, bring back some of their materials. I want to study what kind of creatures they are, so I can sleep well at night.
Alright, I'm counting on you. Don't mess it up — if you do, I'm not cleaning up after you... Just kidding. Good luck.

Now that you mention it, something's been bothering me lately. It's no incident, but it's annoying — what are those green-skinned things and walking bones? They don't look like youkai, and I can't exterminate them. Drive some off for me and I can share a little... reward with you. So, in or out? You look pretty free anyway.
Ah — really? Fine, forget it. It's not like I was counting on you — I'm just too lazy to move myself.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/hostile_loot/option: Ask if the shrine needs help.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/hostile_loot/quest/: Hunt zombies and skeletons for Reimu and collect their flesh and bones.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/local_food/dialog/r: Oh, you're back. So, how did it go?
Not bad, that was quick. Here, your reward. Don't complain it's small — you know how things are at the shrine these days. There used to be youkai visiting; now there's not even a shadow of one...
Marisa always shares mushroom dishes at feasts, and they're pretty tasty. Got any mushrooms? How about mushroom stew and bread?
The rations should last a while longer... though they taste awful. I'll be waiting to hear from you.
Thanks for the generous aid. I hope you can get it ready before I faint from hunger.

Let's not talk about whether I like it — I don't even know what's edible around here. The shrine's stockpiled rations are almost gone. Could you bring me some edible food? If you help out, I can share a little with you — er, as a reward.
Ah — is that so. Never mind, the shrine's rations should last me a while. I'll figure out what's edible around here myself.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/local_food/option/s: Is the food here to your liking?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/local_food/quest/de: Bring Reimu some bread and mushroom stew so she can learn this world's food.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ominous_banner/dial: That's the one. Let me see what this strange banner is saying.
There it is. I'll study what binds these raiders together. Then we'll see what I can do about them.
Take your time. I'll be here.
Check outposts and patrols. That's where you're most likely to find one.
Good. Their captains carry those ominous banners. Take one down and bring it to me. Just watch for the mark they leave behind.
People keep whispering about raiders—armed groups with black-and-white banners. Bring me one from their captain. I want to know what it means.
They're still just humans with weapons. Come back when you're ready to deal with them.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ominous_banner/ques: Bring Reimu an ominous banner from a raid captain.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/raid/dialog/reimu/r: The waves stopped? Good. So the plan worked.
You routed them. I knew baiting them into the village would work. Here—take this border umbrella. It's ready for whatever comes next.
Not yet? Then stay sharp. They won't give up easily.
The village still stands, but the mark is fading. Care to go again? I can set a fresh one.
There. Walk into a village, draw them out, and drive every raider away.
There. The mark is on you. Walk into a village, draw them out, and drive every raider away.
I figured out the mark. My ofuda can recreate it. I'll put it on you; enter a village, draw the raiders in, and drive them out.
I've got shrine duties. You're the one who knows this world, so I'll leave the fighting to you.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/raid/option/complet: Tell Reimu the raid is over.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/raid/quest/desc: Enter a village carrying Reimu's mark and repel the raiders.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/shared/dialog/daily: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see!
gensokyolegacy/reimu/shared/option/daily: Could you go over the task again?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/talisman_materials/: You're back. Got all the materials?
Good, you're reliable after all. With these materials the shrine's ofuda stock is much fuller... Don't worry, I haven't forgotten your share. Here, take these.
No problem. Come find me once the materials are ready, and I'll draw the ofuda for you.
Then I'll wait for good news.
Alright, I'll leave it to you. Once the materials are gathered, I'll draw some ofuda for you as a reward.

You can't exterminate youkai without ofuda. I bet you've run into some nasty youkai on your travels — if you don't like them, beating them up works, but ofuda drive them off even better. I wonder if this place has materials for making them... redstone dust should do.
If you had cinnabar here it'd work even better, but redstone dust is cheaper.
Bring Reimu paper and redstone for her new-world talismans.
patchouli.gensokyolegacy.landing: This volume documents the working side of Gensokyo Legacy: brewing in the Alchemy Pot, paper talismans, combat dolls and their glove, special and everyday tools, and the decoration blocks you can sit on, cover and slide.$(br2)Open it from any Patchouli guide book. An entry shows $(bold)what it does$(), $(bold)how to use it$() and $(bold)where it comes from$().
